summary: First E2E test of Supermarket POS. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (products CRUD, categories, barcode lookup, search/filter, sale creation with stock decrement, sales list newest-first, stats summary). Frontend: full POS flow (scan barcode, search 'coke' auto-add, category filter, product click add to cart, qty inc/dec/remove, discount input, tax 5% calc, payment method toggle, customer modal, printer modal Milestone Y50 58mm, checkout with cash amount+change, receipt modal with RCP- receipt no, history page listing sales, click row reopens receipt, admin create/edit/delete product) all worked. 87 products seeded.

issues: form-category is a <select> dropdown but seed data creates static list; new categories from typing not possible in modal - acceptable for MVP

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown - consider migrating to lifespan handlers.

POS.jsx handleBarcodeSubmit: barcode search still calls /api/products/barcode/{code} for arbitrary text like 'coke' which produces a 404 in console before falling back to filtered[0]. Consider only calling barcode endpoint when input looks numeric.
TAX_RATE hardcoded in POS.jsx and not on backend - could drift; consider config endpoint.
Delete in Admin uses window.confirm (native) - acceptable but not on-brand.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeded 87 products on startup from seed_data.py. No manual seeding needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints all working under /api. Use barcode 8901138836108 for HIMALAYA TOOTHPASTE 150G (₹110) as reliable seeded test product. form-category in Admin modal is a <select>; use select_option not fill. Sales & products stock persist to Mongo. Receipt modal reachable via History page by clicking [data-testid^='sale-'] rows.
